title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks referenced by the other gbf schemas.

rational.description: Exact frame rate as numerator/denominator, e.g. 25/1 or 30000/1001.

relpath.description: POSIX path relative to the repository root or to DATA_ROOT. Absolute paths, drive letters, backslashes and '..' segments are rejected so receipts never leak local paths.

spdx.description: SPDX license expression, or LicenseRef-* for non-SPDX terms.
